## Splitter.SplitByNothing

```m
Splitter.SplitByNothing() as function
```

Category: Splitter · hosts: desktop

Returns a function that does no splitting, returning its argument as a single element list.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

## Splitter.SplitTextByAnyDelimiter

```m
Splitter.SplitTextByAnyDelimiter(delimiters as list, optional quoteStyle as nullable number, optional startAtEnd as nullable logical) as function
```

Category: Splitter · hosts: desktop

Returns a function that splits text into a list of text at any of the specified delimiters.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/splitter-splittextbyanydelimiter)

| `startAtEnd` | `nullable logical` | yes |

## Splitter.SplitTextByCharacterTransition

```m
Splitter.SplitTextByCharacterTransition(before as any, after as any) as function
```

Category: Splitter · hosts: desktop

Returns a function that splits text into a list of text according to a transition from one kind of character to another. The {0} and {1} parameters can either be a list of characters, or a function that takes a character and returns true/false.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/splitter-splittextbycharactertransition)

### Parameters

| `before` | `any` | no |
| `after` | `any` | no |
